summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting supplemental indentures for additional notes issuance. Brookfield Finance II Inc., as issuer, and Brookfield Corporation, as guarantor, executed a supplemental indenture to issue $250 million additional 5.399% Notes due 2055, reopening the existing $650 million series. Terms include same coupon and maturity as original notes, issued at a price to be determined. No board recommendation or advisor named. Structure is a debt issuance under existing indenture, with no change of control, premium, or special-situation event. The filing is a routine debt takedown, not a special situation.
